assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official precise polygon, CAD, or GIS redline has not been published. The announcement gives three-level scope areas and text descriptions of boundaries, but the prequalification package requires a download password. The repository provides provisional rough boundaries via provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: All geometry files are labeled provisional_constraint, official_boundary=false. They can only be used for generation, display, and discussion—not as official redline, approval basis, or precise area calculation.

assumptions.statement: Every AI city service must have a parallel non-AI track. Four checkable conditions: equivalent path, human handoff, exit right, retirement record. Services missing any condition remain blocked.
assumptions.impact: All 10 scenario cards have been self-checked against four conditions (status: provisional). No field verification has been conducted yet.

assumptions.statement: No field survey or on-site observation has been authorized or conducted. All performance metrics for AI scenarios are marked as unverified.
assumptions.impact: Scenario card performance is uniformly registered as unverified. No operational claims without field evidence.

assumptions.statement: Building counts, heights, function ratios, and retain/renovate/demolish ratios are conceptual estimates based on industry positioning, not current-condition surveys.
assumptions.impact: All building-level parameters are B-level (conceptual). Official current-condition survey and structural safety assessment required before any demolition or renovation decisions.

assumptions.statement: Public Issue #1029 notes the Dazhongsi provisional key area may be misaligned with the actual station. This package treats the area as a relocatable design container, not as a basis for precise station-entrance or parcel-level claims.
assumptions.impact: Dazhongsi key area polygon is used for design container checking only, not for precise siting or development volume claims.

assumptions.statement: Investment estimates are concept-level (±50% precision) based on comparable public projects. Six projects total 10.4-21.6 billion RMB.
assumptions.impact: Formal estimates require professional cost consultancy after detailed design, engineering geology, market conditions, and approval pathways are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Operations governance, funding model, and phased implementation are conceptual frameworks. No operator has been selected, no funding committed, no approval pathway confirmed.
assumptions.impact: All operational and financial parameters are C-level (implementation assumptions). Light-weight pilots should precede any capital-intensive construction.
